sprint.title: Player Intent Interpretation V1
sprint.goal: Implement the owner-accepted October 30 interpretation contract and authority-preserving Coordinator handoff; local review only.
scope: Model-independent V1 interpretation, strict validation, replaceable invocation, trusted Coordinator handoff, clarification and technical failure containment. Preserve F05, domain ownership, acceptance, continuity, envelope V3/schema 4 and historical saves.
No gameplay mechanics, narration integration, persistence changes, inference experiments, permanent model selection, Git staging/committing/publication or subsequent package.
verification: Syntax checks, focused structural and semantic-boundary fixtures, cross-domain acceptance/retry/recovery/compatibility regressions, lifecycle validation, maintained GitWorkflowTools checks and diff review. All provider calls forbidden.
